scenerySelection.note: Coastlines and substantial water retain the full terrain extent. Ordinary buildings are restricted to the source Changi airport polygon; local primary roads and large land use only.

seaDerivation.method: OSM coastline polygonization with island holes and bounded display clipping

osm.geometryClipping: Every feature is clipped to the DEM/scenery selection rectangle; coast-derived sea retains island holes.
